cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Return to the First Hope
cards.instruction: Return to an early hope after every setback, expanding its meaning until the whole scene seems to fulfill it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. We wanted somewhere to belong. This leaking cottage can still be ours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then we'll know every tile of the place we belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We hoped for a home, not an untouched savings account beside someone else's house.

mechanism: Copy a builder's floor marks as bedroom planning, then keep expanding the hope of a shared home to include dismantling and temporary camping.
confusable: Not D209 future victory investment: the same early hope of belonging must be fulfilled by the setbacks themselves, while A denies its marking mistake.
comparison: Partners making a home amid repair differ from organizers finding community in a powerless concert.
seedUse: Retains leaking cottage/shared home hope; uses rotten floor and temporary tent instead of roof/savings.
